description: The vaults we read, so a caller holding a name rather than a slug can find the one it means. Free. Absence from this list means we do not read that vault, never that it does not exist. `displayName` is capped at 80 characters here, cut with … when longer; the full name is in vault_check and at /v1/vaults/{slug}.

limit.description: Default 25, capped at 100, or 1000 with export.bulk; meta.limit says what was applied and what held it. Above 1000 is refused with 400, never cut.

minRating.description: A floor on the ASPERN rating: minRating=B keeps B, B+ and every A. A vault not rated, or with no stored due-diligence document, never passes. Each row carries the letter as `aspernRating`, the one vault_rating gives.

offset.description: Where to start, for the next page: send the `nextOffset` of the previous answer. Default 0.

q.description: Part of a vault or platform name, matched as typed.

sort.description: tvl (default: capital, the larger first) or rating: A+ first, equal letters by capital; vaults without a letter follow by capital. meta.pagination.orderedBy states it.

name: list_vaults

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

data.description: Each with its slug, which is what vault_check takes, and `displayName` capped at 80 characters (cut with …; the full name is in vault_check).

fields.description: Which fields this tool kept from the endpoint’s own rows, and where the rest are.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Find the vault you mean
